svg.title: vibe check Architecture
svg.desc: How metacognitive oversight, blast-radius scanning, persistent memory, and fail-safe gating guard AI agent plans.

g.text: Pre-flight plan verification, blast-radius scanning, persistent memory & auto-revision loop
Serving true user intent vs drift
Appended to autosession history for review continuity
* Malformed or faulted verdict defaults to BLOCK
• Hard risk or missing safety check found
Local-first, zero-telemetry persistent memory power-steering review context across sessions
• Evaluated on every plan before gating
• Tracks retry attempts & avoids repeat loops
